name: Dorchester Foodbank
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at Dorchester Community Church. Open Tue 10am-2pm. Referral required via local agencies.

name: Dorset Council Allotments
short_description: Dorset Council allotment sites in Dorchester area
description: Council manages sites at Dorchester and Poundbury. Plots from £35/year. Waiting lists operate. Includes water access and storage facilities.

name: Dorchester Community Garden
description: Volunteer-run community garden within Borough Gardens Victorian park. Grows seasonal vegetables with harvest shared among volunteers. Historic park setting.
